text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three important years for <chrname> had passed. 
It was time to mark a milestone in her 
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukoma Hot Spring Resort was bustling with 
energy, and life at the academy was going 
smoothly as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I finished sorting the photos 
from the party the other day, so I'm 
sending them over!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that night was so much fun, wasn't 
it! It felt just like the Dragon Palace~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, the people of the hot 
spring town had honored us with a banquet 
thrown in our celebration!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us make a toast. ...Though 
it is only juice♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
With heartfelt gratitude to everyone who 
helped rebuild our Yukoma Hot Spring 
Resort~~!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeeers~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer really took great care of us too, 
didn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Eat up and fill your bellies! Can't serve 
any booze with kids around, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After making merry at the banquet, we 
soaked in the hot springs once more... and 
fell asleep in the fluffy futons...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Satisfaction level: 120%... Remembering it 
makes my chest feel warm. Repeat visit, 
requested...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Let's do this next time I win 
instead, okay? I'll invite eeeveryone♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, big words! Can't let myself fall 
behind, then.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll win abroad, and when I come 
back, we'll celebrate big time...♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! It's not like I'm running just to 
get time off, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"When you give it your absolute all on 
regular days, it makes resting and having 
fun even more enjoyable!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I agree. This whole cycle is what makes a 
great racing career...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's true. Rest seriously, run 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and humans alike, let's stay 
healthy forever! Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume were frolicking during lunch 
break. Of course, classes await them in 
the afternoon, and training after school.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! You have a video from karaoke~!? Show 
me, show me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both spirit and stamina are fully charged! 
All right, let's do our healthy best this 
week too—!
